behavior: Given an authorized empty real OpenSearch store, bootstrap installs the active log-debug-v1 daily index under ISM policy log-debug-retention-v1, and policy GET plus ISM explain show a hot default state whose only terminal transition enters a delete state at min_index_age 7d and deletes that index.
rationale: The policy identity, state names, age threshold, and terminal action are owner-approved constants, so an example checked against public OpenSearch reads discriminates exact seven-day ISM retention from mapping metadata, a wrong age, or a non-delete terminal state.
